project.name: Cordit
project.tagline: Public stranger chat + voice with live observer mode, music sharing, and dynamic wallpaper glassmorphism

scope_and_maturity_reality_check.summary: Engineering maturity audit separating verified shipped components from active branches and aspirational roadmap items.

shipped_and_verified: Numeric Anonymous Public IDs (#7368) decoupled from Mongo ObjectIds
JWT-based dual authentication (Public ID or Username + Password)
Ultra-Clear Frosted Glassmorphism UI (12-35% opacity with backdrop-blur-md/xl)
Wallpaper Theming Engine with 8 bespoke artworks and CSS variable reactivity
Violet moonlit glassmorphic login & register portals with eye show/hide toggle
Basic LiveKit WebRTC SFU voice connect and mute controls (local dev binary)
Next.js App Router API route proxy (frontend:3001 -> backend:3000)
Admin control dashboard for viewing reports and managing user accounts
active_in_development_branch: Mutual gender preference matching queue logic (matchingService.ts)
100% Public stranger room broadcast with observer counter updates
Spectator suggestions system (chat:suggestion:send and visibility toggles)
One-click user blocking and room incident snapshot reporting
beta_experimental: Browser tab audio capture for music sharing (desktop Chromium only, zero transcode)
Dynamic audio waveform spectrum meters synchronized to speaking loudness
planned_roadmap_unshipped: Horizontal matching scale via Redis Sorted Sets & Pub/Sub
Automated speech-to-text (Whisper/Deepgram) voice moderation audit pipeline
Automated CSAM/NSFW media hashing (PhotoDNA/Perceptual hash checks)
Age gate verification (18+) and COPPA/GDPR-K compliance workflows
Observer suggestion rate limiting and Sybil attack prevention

legal_safety_and_moderation_risk_assessm.overall_risk_profile: CRITICAL / HIGH RISK — Public stranger chat and real-time voice broadcasting present severe moderation, child safety, and legal liabilities requiring immediate production safeguards.

risk_factors.threat: Unmonitored stranger chat platforms attract bad actors. Public broadcast increases exposure velocity exponentially.
risk_factors.current_status: Manual user reporting only. Inadequate for public production.
mandatory_controls: Mandatory 18+ age verification gate and clear Terms of Service acknowledgment at registration.
Automated perceptual media hashing (PhotoDNA / PDQ) on file upload endpoints before storage.
Automated NCMEC reporting integration for any identified child sexual abuse material.

risk_factors.threat: Voice streams are ephemeral and undetectable by text filters. Bad actors can broadcast hate speech, harassment, or illegal audio to observers without leaving an audit trail.
risk_factors.current_status: No voice recording, transcription, or automated moderation pipeline exists.
required_architecture: LiveKit Egress Service connected to a rolling in-memory 30-second encrypted audio buffer.
Buffer is permanently discarded unless a user presses 'Report Voice'.
Upon report, audio snippet is sent to an asynchronous speech-to-text engine (OpenAI Whisper or Deepgram) and evaluated with a toxicity/hate-speech classifier.

risk_factors.domain: GDPR, DPA & Privacy in Public Broadcasts
risk_factors.threat: Broadcasting conversations and voice to unverified spectators raises severe privacy, consent, and wiretapping concerns under GDPR, UK DPA, and two-party consent jurisdictions.
required_safeguards: Prominent 'Public Room Disclosure' banner before user connects to voice or text.
Explicit consent opt-in for spectator observation.
Right to Erasure API (/api/user/delete) that wipes user profile, message logs, and IP history.

matching_engine.current_implementation: Single-process in-memory TypeScript Map/Array in backend/src/services/matchingService.ts.
matching_engine.bottlenecks: Cannot scale beyond a single Node.js instance. Process restart clears waiting queue. Memory leak risk under high concurrency.

production_scaling_target.mechanism: Use Redis Sorted Sets (ZADD queue:<gender_pref> <timestamp> <publicId>) for FIFO matching and Redis Pub/Sub for cross-worker match notifications. Cluster-safe and survives server restarts.

rate_limiting_and_anti_spam.current_implementation: express-rate-limit applied to HTTP moderation routes (10 requests / 5 minutes in backend/src/routes/moderation.ts).
rate_limiting_and_anti_spam.deficit_identified: WebSocket suggestion submission (chat:suggestion:send in backend/src/utils/socket.ts) has NO rate limiter. A malicious observer can flood the participant screen with hundreds of suggestions per minute.
rate_limiting_and_anti_spam.production_remedy: Implement a Token Bucket / Sliding Window rate limiter in Socket.io middleware allowing max 1 suggestion per 30 seconds per Public ID / IP.

voice_webrtc_topology.development_mode: Single binary LiveKit Server running locally with --dev flag (bin/livekit/livekit-server.exe).
production_topology: Multi-node LiveKit SFU cluster deployed behind HAProxy / Nginx ingress with TLS certificates.
Dedicated STUN/TURN servers (Coturn or LiveKit Cloud) for NAT traversal across restrictive firewalls.
LiveKit Egress workers deployed on separate worker nodes to handle audio buffering and stream recordings without degrading SFU packet routing.

network_proxy_and_cors_topology.mechanism: Next.js Route Handler at frontend/app/api/[...path]/route.ts acts as an internal HTTP reverse proxy forwarding all client API calls to BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL (http://localhost:3000).
network_proxy_and_cors_topology.advantages: Eliminates browser CORS friction in local development, forwards authorization headers transparently, and supports standard HTTPS reverse-proxying in containerized production.

navigation_model.routing_strategy: Hybrid Next.js Routes + Client-side Tab State
navigation_model.workspace_tabs: The main dashboard (/) uses Zustand client state (activeTab: 'stranger' | 'rooms' | 'voice' | 'library') rather than hash anchors, preventing fragile URL fragment routing in modern SPA frameworks.
